title: National Quantum Initiative Act
summary: Set up the National Quantum Initiative to coordinate federal quantum research and education, and the DOE National Quantum Information Science Research Centers.

title: CHIPS and Science Act
summary: Broad science law that includes quantum provisions, such as quantum networking and workforce programs at NSF and DOE.

title: Quantum Computing Cybersecurity Preparedness Act
summary: Requires federal agencies to plan the move of their systems to post-quantum cryptography.

title: Post-quantum cryptography standards (FIPS 203, 204 and 205)
summary: NIST's first finalized post-quantum encryption and signature standards, based on ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA.

title: Ushering in the Next Frontier of Quantum Innovation
summary: Orders an updated National Quantum Strategy within 180 days, an effort to deliver a quantum computer for scientific discovery to a DOE facility, five-year quantum sensing and networking plans, and workforce and supply chain measures.
